multi_char_tounicode.finding: a ToUnicode bfchar may map one CID to a string, so the decoy needs no length congruence and no language model

leakage.note: generic overlap is shared everyday English, not a leak

bugs_found_by_measurement: percentile-subtract denoising leaves half-wave rectified noise across the measurement window and drags centroids by 3+ px, more than the signal; a hard ink threshold fixes it
computing the text bounding box from an unthresholded ink projection makes a noisy page's bbox the whole page, so normalisation rescaled by the wrong factor
ink-connectivity word segmentation inverts every bit after a split or merged glyph; analytic windows from the layout map avoid it
a per-line linear detrend is needed to absorb residual affine error from photographs, and is safe because the paired encoding is trend-free
